name: file-icons

frames.best_why: Full icon grid and source tree are shown together with a file row highlighted on hover.

tagline: A grid of file-type and brand icons above a matching file tree.
summary: A collection of monochrome icons for file types, languages and developer tools, with a helper that picks the right glyph from a file extension. The demo shows them in a labelled grid and a small source tree.
appearance: A grid of dark bordered tiles, each holding a white monochrome glyph and a small grey label. Below it a bordered panel lists src files under a folder heading, each row with a tiny icon and a monospace filename.
behaviour: The glyphs themselves are static; hovering a tile or a file row tints its background grey. A helper swaps the icon according to the supplied file extension.
demo_content: Labels like logo, twitter, react, tailwind, json, ts, css; files package.json, globals.css, button.tsx, utils.ts.
search_phrases: file type icons for a code editor
icon set for a file tree
use_when: A file tree, editor tab bar or docs list needs a matching glyph for each file type.
avoid_when: You need colourful brand logos or types beyond the included extensions; others fall back to a generic file.
customise: Pick an icon by key or call the extension helper; colour follows currentColor and classes. Adding a new file type means editing the source.
weight_why: Inline SVG paths with CSS-only hover colours; no animation or runtime loop.

a11y.note: Icons are decorative and marked aria-hidden in the demo, and the SVGs carry no titles of their own.

issues: Only json, css and js/ts family extensions map to icons; everything else gets a generic file glyph.
The file rows are static list items, not real links or selectable files.
polish_why: A wide, consistent monochrome set with tidy labels and a clear file-tree example.
